title: corbularia aurea
intro: Corbularia aurea, commonly known as the Goldenseal, is a plant species in the family Berberidaceae. The health benefits of Corbularia aurea include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Corbularia aurea include berberine, which has been shown to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, and hydrastine, which has been found to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
